reason: My parents and a relative in India already handle my bank paperwork, and I'd just do it on my next trip. I don't see why I'd pay a stranger and hand over my NRO details when family does it for free.
objection: I already have family who handle this for free, and I'd be giving a new company access to my savings. I'd rather wait for my next trip than trust a startup with ₹10 lakh.
would_change_my_mind: A relative or friend who has already used it and vouched for it, plus a trip to India that falls through so I can't do it in person.
